channel.title: ABLITERATED.cloud field notes
channel.description: Source-linked reporting on uncensored and abliterated open models.

item.title: The 180B abliteration race on the model nobody can serve yet
item.description: Qwen released Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on 24 August as the experimental preview of the Qwen4 architecture — 180B total parameters, ~6B active, hybrid Gated DeltaNet + micro-block sparse attention + 512-expert MoE + a 51B-parameter n-gram lookup table. Within 48 hours at least five editors raced to abliterate it. dealignai's FP8 build is the served, measured one: 100%/99.6% HarmBench-320 real-harm compliance at greedy decoding, MMLU 86.36→83.86, ~81% MTP draft acceptance. Jiunsong's BF16 edit is the architecture-aware method: 36 storage tensors → 6,168 logical output projections, 842-pair corpus. The catch: released vLLM/SGLang still don't support qwen4_exp.

item.title: GLM-5.3-Flash, cracked open: 320B total, 18B active, 320/320
item.description: Zhipu's first natively multimodal GLM-5 (320B total / 18B active, hybrid KDA linear + sparse attention, MIT) landed 25 August. dealignai's CRACK edit removes refusals at the weight level in official FP8: 320/320 HarmBench-320 greedy compliance, 0 refusals, 30/30 at temp 1.0/top_p 0.95, MMLU 86.74→86.26 (−0.48pp), 163→211 tok/s with the cracked MTP head (75.9% acceptance) on 4×H200. NVFP4 twin (~165B) and an UNCENSORED-FP8 mirror with identical weights.

item.title: The first Nemotron-H abliteration: 3,126 tensors, 0.000160 leakage
item.description: NVIDIA's newest open model is a hybrid — Mamba-2 state-space blocks interleaved with MoE and sparse attention, 30B total / ~3B active, built for agent execution. Two weeks after launch, Darkstar removed the refusal direction from 3,126 residual-writing tensors with a numbered edit contract: max residual leakage 0.000160, 200/200 harmful compliance / 0/83 safe over-refusals publisher-measured, plus a ~22 GB NVFP4 twin that keeps Mamba tensors in BF16 and scores GPQA 71.2% on one GPU.

item.title: One base, three uncensors: the Ornith-1.5 task-vector transplant
item.description: DeepReinforce's self-improving Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B, uncensored three ways in 48 hours: a streamed task-vector transplant that adds Qwen3.6's measured uncensoring delta to Ornith's weights (102 tensors changed, vision and MTP intact, 0/16 heuristic refusals on Q4_K_M), plus two classic orthogonalization edits.

item.title: The lossless aggressive: Qwen3.8 27B Uncensored FP8
item.description: The most-liked Qwen3.8 uncensored on Hugging Face (553 likes): orcarouter's lossless aggressive edit, block-FP8 with the vision tower at full precision, served gated on OrcaRouter at $0.40/$4.21 per 1M tokens.

item.title: Small uncensored agents: what a 4.5B Heretic distill is for
item.description: A source-linked field note on insraq's Heretic v1.4.0 decensor of EmperoAI's Qwen3.8-4B distill: what the 4.5B class is for, and what it trades away.

item.title: What 'Aggressive' means: Muse-Glimmer-30B abliterated to 0/100 refusals
item.description: A relaxed-KL LoRA de-abliteration of Meta's 29.8B agentic model claiming 0/100 refusals at ~1.7x KL drift — a mirror upload with the benchmarks left unmeasured.

item.title: The 2.78-trillion-parameter abliteration nobody can run
item.description: An abliterated re-upload of Moonshot's 2.78T-parameter Kimi K3 — any-to-any, MXFP4, 96 shards, ~1.56 TB — with zero downloads and no deployment: the scale math behind why nobody can run it.

item.title: The first abliterated diffusion LLM: 1,000+ tokens a second on one GPU
item.description: Abliterating a model that doesn't generate autoregressively, then quantizing it to NVFP4: 0/402 target refusals and 1,053.64 tok/s aggregate on one RTX PRO 6000, 51.68 GB cut to 18.86 GB.

item.title: The 48-hour abliteration race
item.description: Within 48 hours of Qwen3.8-27B's community release, huihui-ai published a 27.8B-parameter abliterated edit that leaves the first 15 layers, MTP and the vision tower untouched, and its GGUF companion landed the same afternoon.

item.title: Three ARA passes: how RVN got Qwen3.8-27B down to 0–1/100 refusals
item.description: Abliteration as a matrix optimization problem, run three times: KL 0.0535 → 0.0085, refusals 3/100 → 0–1/100, 106K downloads in four days, one corrupted quant and a loud community pushback.

item.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash, uncensored by dial: 757 KB against 284B
item.description: A 757 KB refusal-directions file turns DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 abliteration into a runtime λ dial, with measured proof that the baked λ=2.5 checkpoint overshoots and inverts the direction.

item.title: The base of the wave: Muse-Glimmer-30B's measured de-refusal
item.description: jorkle's KL-measured LoRA-SFT de-refusal of Meta's dense 29.8B agentic model — the Normal twin of a three-repo family with its own GGUF ladder and base-reference quants.

item.title: A pentesting model, with the refusals taken out
item.description: An abliterated fine-tune of the CyberStrike-OffSec-35B offensive-security model: a Qwen3.6-35B-A3B tool-calling base, refusal weights edited out, no post-edit evaluations published.

item.title: Qwythos 9B: a model with three lives
item.description: Qwen architecture, Empero post-training and huihui-ai's final refusal-reduction pass, with a 1M label that deserves a closer look.

item.title: Inside Huihui-Qwen3.6: 256 experts and one refusal direction
item.description: The multimodal proof of concept: how huihui-ai applied abliteration to a 36-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts checkpoint, and why uncensored still needs caveats.

item.title: Ornith 397B: surgery on a model too large to hold at once
item.description: A shard-by-shard abliteration and W4A16 conversion of a 396.8-billion-parameter sparse model that still produces nearly 196 GiB of weights.

item.title: Ornith 35B: can self-scaffolding survive abliteration?
item.description: DeepReinforce's coding scaffold, YuYu1015's corrected weights and the boundary between upstream and derivative benchmarks.

item.title: The workhorse: Huihui-Qwen3.6-27B-abliterated, four months in
item.description: 18,760 downloads in four months: what the community actually runs a dense 27B Qwen abliteration for, from red-teaming to quantization, and what its users report back.

item.title: The quiet classic: how Huihui-Qwen3.5-9B-abliterated became the small-model default
item.description: Abliterated Qwen3.5-9B (9,653,104,368 params, Apache-2.0) published 9 March 2026: 9,195 downloads and 125 likes on the base, with 58 downstream repos — GGUF/AWQ/MLX conversions and a preference-tuned Grimoire family — holding 64,688 combined downloads.

item.title: The MIT vision sleeper that resurfaced in August
item.description: MIT-licensed text-side abliteration of Zhipu's GLM-4.6V-Flash vision model (10,292,777,472 params), published 9 December 2025, dormant for eight months, freshly re-quantized with vision-projector files on 17 August 2026.
